newsitem.title: USA: Greater Bay files for preferred securities.
newsitem.headline: Greater Bay files for preferred securities.

text.p: A business trust formed by Greater Bay Bancorp filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 800,000 cumulative trust preferred securities.
The trust, known as GBB Capital I will use the proceeds from the offering to invest in junior subordinated deferrable interest debentures of Greater Bay Bancorp.

The corporation intends to invest the proceeds from the sale of the debentures in the banks to increase their capital levels to support future growth. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes.
The preferred securities have a liquidation amount of $25 per preferred securities, the filing said. The offering will be made through Piper Jaffray Inc.
Greater Bay, based in Palo Alto, Calif., is a bank holding company operating Cupertino National Bank & Trust and Mid-Peninsula Bank.
At December 31, 1996, the company had total assets of $622 million, total net loans of $441.6 million and total deposits of $559.3 million, the filing said.
